propositions: Comment identity must be based on persistent HLC timestamp → Jira comment ID mapping instead of normalized body text to prevent collisions on duplicate bodies and re-sync on edits

The Jira-returned comment ID from add_comment must be captured at both enactment sites (create_one and update_one via _apply_outbound_update) and persisted via record_comment_id with write-ahead durability
Comment sync append-only semantics: outbound skip when key is mapped OR jira_comment_id present; inbound skip logic unchanged; never re-sync a mapped key/ID pair

Outbound comment bodies must render through RichTextCodec.to_wire with fit-then-encode ordering (fit text before json.dumps) and _resolve_codec migrated from _IdentityCodec to the real codec for convergent dedup
Comment diff must converge with zero duplicates after codec migration and remain idempotent on repeat reconcile passes
Per-comment map entries are change-gated (no churn) and crash-safe; lost map write does not trigger re-post due to demoted body-equality secondary skip guard
